tasks.subject: Task 1: checkpoint_x + checkpoint-aware evaluate_curriculum
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The evaluator can terminate an episode early when the ball crosses a moving finish line, reporting that crossing as the stage-advancement signal; with no checkpoint it behaves exactly as today.

**Files:** src/blueball/ai/curriculum.py, src/blueball/cli.py, tests/test_ai_curriculum.py, tests/test_climb_fitness.py

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/blueball/ai/curriculum.py", "src/blueball/cli.py", "tests/test_ai_curriculum.py", "tests/test_climb_fitness.py"], "verifyCommand": "SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_ai_curriculum.py tests/test_climb_fitness.py -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["CurriculumStage.checkpoint_x defaults None", "evaluate_curriculum 8-tuple terminates+reports reached at checkpoint", "checkpoint_x None unchanged", "all tuple callers updated", "full suite green"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Forward-curriculum build path + LevelMeta fields
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A level can declare start_gated: true (with optional curriculum_checkpoints), and build_spawn_curriculum emits forward stages — all spawning at the true start, ascending checkpoints, final stage running to the real goal.

**Files:** src/blueball/levels/loader.py, src/blueball/ai/curriculum.py, tests/test_ai_curriculum.py

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/blueball/levels/loader.py", "src/blueball/ai/curriculum.py", "tests/test_ai_curriculum.py"], "verifyCommand": "SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_ai_curriculum.py -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["LevelMeta start_gated + curriculum_checkpoints populated", "forward stages spawn at start, granted 0, ascending checkpoint_x, final None", "keys fallback when checkpoints omitted", "reverse path unaffected", "full suite green"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Flip maze.json to start-gated + migrate reverse tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The maze trains forward by default (the A/B-proven direction), and the reverse code path keeps a regression guard via a flag-stripped maze dict.

**Files:** src/blueball/levels/maze.json, tests/test_ai_curriculum.py

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/blueball/levels/maze.json", "tests/test_ai_curriculum.py"], "verifyCommand": "SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["maze.json start_gated + 5 checkpoints", "build_spawn_curriculum(maze) 6 forward stages first cp 300 last None spawn 80", "reverse tests migrated to stripped dict still assert receding", "forward smoke run advances stages", "full suite green"]}
```
